sv.title: 64 dagar utan regering – detta har hänt
sv.summary: Det har nu gått 64 dagar sedan valdagen. Ännu är det oklart vilken regering Sverige ska få. Här är turerna i regeringsbildningen.

en.title: 64 days without a government – here is what has happened
en.summary: It has now been 64 days since election day. It is still unclear which government Sweden will get. Here is how the government formation has unfolded.
